tools.name: search_screens
tools.description: Find real examples of website screens captured from live sites: login and sign-up pages, pricing pages, checkouts, carts, search results, home pages, forms with errors and more, on desktop and mobile, across sectors such as banking, insurance, software, retail and travel. Use it for UI and UX inspir

tools.name: get_screen
tools.description: Read one captured screen by its id (from search_screens): site, device, type, sector, state, summary, the interface elements marked on it, a thumbnail and the link to the full screenshot on theuiindex.com.

tools.name: list_screen_types
tools.description: List the screen types (login, pricing, checkout…), sectors (banking, software…) and interface states (form error, empty cart…) The UI Index uses, with how many screens each has. Use the keys as search_screens filters.
